2095565695.annotation: Extremely high damage for 4.8k. Slot efficient item.

3977876567.annotation: This item is broken on Abrams, it reloads his gun due to his special reload mechanic and gives him fire rate he's desperate for.

3791587546.annotation: Need a flex slot to buy this, can be delayed in order to buy a green 3k counter item. Every stat on this item is overpowered.

800008313.annotation: 1st Slotlock buy | You can either buy this if you feel like continuing to be a caveman late, or sell Melee Charge and buy Crippling Headshot

1427630806.annotation: 2nd Slotlock buy | You want to keep Healing Booster's effect, this makes it better by increasing effectiveness and giving you fire rate. Small bonus stats+Green invest.

619484391.annotation: Replace Improved Spirit (buy Boundless later) | Can buy to counter every character's defensive cooldowns before or after landing a charge.

3884003354.annotation: Can replace Melee Charge/Crushing Fists. Should fairly frequently. Abrams' best anti-heal+shred option.

630839635.annotation: One shot people off landing a charge in most cases. Be mindful as you don't have duration and could be parried on the 2nd charge.

3357231760.annotation: Highest priority item in this category. Gets you to 52% debuff resist with a 7 second unstop on a 58s cooldown. Far better than max ult IMO.

2407781327.annotation: Gigantic stat stick. About all that it has going for it.

1414319208.annotation: Gun Dmg Focus Item 1 | ALWAYS BUY WITH BLOOD TRIBUTE! Huge stat stick. Replaces Weighted Shots.

989206714.annotation: Gun Dmg Focus Item 2 | ALWAYS BUY WITH BERSERKER! Use to stack Berserker outside of fights and abuse the stats it gives you. Replaces a green 3k.

2481177645.annotation: If you bought duration/slowing hex/silence wave and can't fit BRS, you should exchange Point Blank for this to have shred.

1798666702.annotation: In theory, this item has a lot of stats Abrams wants. In practice, its competing for item slots with better gun 3ks, or green 3ks. Super hard to find space for this.

2462046703.annotation: If AFK lane: Buy 1st Item, sell after 10 minutes, hatch at 1300/1400

2617435668.annotation: If your team has no other curse buyer and you're low networth this can help win the game in some matchups

3633614685.annotation: Buy instead of melee lifesteal when needed. Comparable to purchasing a barrier for less souls and it doesn't have to be procced.

3074274290.annotation: Compy donkey...? Could build instead of Battle Vest as you get enough bullet resist from other items.

2447176615.annotation: If you have subpar movement this can help you a lot. Genuinely not necessary if you're using movement tools. Decent against slows if you really need to.

334300056.annotation: If you want 7 stamina AND can execute IADs, you can take this. Likely a better item after charge cancel death.

951866250.annotation: Reactive Barrier upgrade. Sort of a noob trap item because better players will be mindful of this and proc it before using important CC.
